meta.title: Nyeaka - Device Sharing Platform
meta.description: Nyeaka is a device sharing platform that allows users to share their devices with others. It provides a secure and convenient way to share devices, making it easier for people to access the technology they need. Set up by Paradigm Initiatives, Nyeaka aims to foster a collaborative and resource-efficient environment where users can easily share and access devices, promoting sustainability and reducing electronic waste.

header.homeLabel: Nyeaka home, a Paradigm Initiative project

footer.tagline: A free device-donation marketplace for Africa. No fees, no middlemen, no resale.

hero.title: The laptop you stopped using still works.
hero.subtitle: Every one of those devices was sitting unused in someone's home until somebody listed it. Nyeaka is free, has no middlemen and takes no cut — members are ID-verified, then they meet and hand over themselves.
hero.give: I have a device to give
hero.disclaimer: Nyeaka never handles the device, the meetup, or money — there is none.
hero.statsNote: Roughly two in three listings are claimed within a week. Phones move fastest; laptops travel furthest.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Nyeaka is a free device-donation marketplace, a project of Paradigm Initiative. This page explains what we collect, why, who can see it and how to remove it. We write it in plain language on purpose.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: Nyeaka is run by Paradigm Initiative, which decides how your personal data is used on the platform. You can reach us through the contact page.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
Your account: name, email, password (stored only as a one-way hash), country and language. Optionally a phone number.

What you do: listings, requests, offers, chat messages, ratings and reports you make.

To verify who you are: the type of ID document, the name on it, its expiry date if it has one, a one-way code made from the document number (never the number itself), and photos of the document and of you holding it.

Technical data: your sign-in sessions, with the device and network address they came from, so we can keep accounts safe.

why.title: Why we use it
why.body:
To run the service: show your posts, match people in the same country and let two people arrange a handoff.

To keep people safe: verifying identity, handling reports and stopping repeat abuse.

To meet legal duties and respond to valid requests from authorities.

We use your ID documents only to check who you are. We do not use any of your data for advertising and we never sell it.

documents.title: Your ID documents
documents.body:
Only a Nyeaka reviewer sees your document photos, through links that stop working after a minute. Each time a reviewer looks, it is recorded. Your profile only ever shows a Verified badge.

The photos are deleted 30 days after we decide. If nobody reviews a submission within 30 days, it is closed and the photos are deleted. Location and device details are removed from the photos on your phone before they are uploaded.

If we suspend an account for abuse, we keep the one-way code of its document number for 12 months so the same document can't be used to verify a new account, then we delete it.

sharing.title: Who else sees your data
sharing.body:
Other people see your first name and last initial, country, member-since date, verified badge, ratings and written reviews. Your listing or request shows your general area, never your street. Your phone number is shown to the other person only when you both choose to share it.

We use service providers to run Nyeaka: hosting and database, file storage, and email delivery. They process data on our behalf and may store it outside your country.

We share data with authorities only when the law requires it.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body:
Your account data stays until you delete your account in Settings. Deleting removes your name, email, phone, photo, ID documents and sign-in, and closes your posts. Messages stay in the chats of the people you talked to, shown as from a deleted user. Reports about or by you are kept for safety.

Technical session records are removed when you sign out or they expire.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, to object to how we use it, and to complain to the data protection authority in your country (see below). You can delete your account yourself in Settings. For anything else, contact us and we will answer within 30 days.

children.title: Children
children.body: Nyeaka is for people aged 18 or over. If we learn that someone younger has an account, we will close it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before it takes effect.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These are the rules for using Nyeaka. By creating an account you agree to them.

accept.title: Using Nyeaka
accept.body: You must be 18 or over and live in a country where Nyeaka is available. Nyeaka is free, and always will be: nobody may charge for a device or for introductions.

account.title: Your account and verification
account.body: Give true information and keep your sign-in private. You need a verified identity to list a device, ask for one or send an offer. One person, one account.

posts.title: Your listings and requests
posts.body: List only devices you own and can give away, described honestly. Wipe your personal data from a device before handing it over. Ask only for a device you genuinely need, and never to resell it.

handoff.title: Meeting and handing over
handoff.body: Handoffs happen in person. Meet in a public, busy place, bring a friend if you can, and inspect the device before accepting. Nyeaka introduces people; it is not a party to what they agree.

conduct.title: What is not allowed
conduct.body: Fraud, harassment, spam, illegal or stolen devices, selling or charging for donated devices, fake or duplicate accounts, or trying to get around verification.

role.title: Our role
role.body: Nyeaka connects donors and people who need devices. We do not own, inspect or guarantee any device, and we are not responsible for what happens between people. Nothing here limits rights you have under the law where you live.

suspension.title: Reports, restriction and suspension
suspension.body: Anyone you have dealt with can report or block you. Repeated reports can restrict your account automatically, and we can suspend accounts that break these rules. A suspended person can't sign in.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If we change these terms in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before they apply.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: For questions about Nyeaka, your data, a report or your verification, write to us.
contact.noEmail: Our contact address is being set up. Please check back soon.
contact.safety: If someone is in danger, contact your local emergency services first.
